messages:
maria_cs: Okay team — we have the Multi-Account Bootcamp next month. Need to split into concurrent tracks (Intro / Migrations / Dedicated) to accommodate ~120 customers. Can mentors cover concurrent rooms? We also need timezone-friendly slots for NA/EU/APAC. Quick poll here: https://tinyurl.com/bootcamp-poll

tim_ops: Heads-up: some customers are on renewal watchlist (Acme, NovaCare) — they should get priority 1:1s. Suggest reserving 8 priority seats per track.

akash_enable: I can cover EU mornings and APAC evenings. Mentor pool right now: Lina, Raj, Chen, Priya, Marco + me — total 6. Not enough for 3 fully parallel live tracks if we keep 1:1s.

jamie_csm: We could do 2 live tracks + 1 recorded deep dive + a live Q&A window afterwards. That reduces mentor headcount and still gives live coverage. :thinking_face:

lina_mentor: Agreed. Also FYI we need JP localization for APAC live — can we record and add subtitles? Ops can probably run ASR -> subs pipeline.

maria_cs: Quick proposed schedule (UTC) — thoughts:
```
09:00-10:30 Intro (NA-friendly)
11:00-12:30 Migrations (EU-friendly)
20:00-21:30 Dedicated (APAC-friendly, JP live)
```
Reserve priority seats and mark renewal-risk customers for 1:1 follow-ups.

tim_ops: Draft capacity calc: `Mentors available = 6, Seats per track = 40, Priority seats = 8`. If we do two live + recorded, mentors needed = 4. That works with current pool.

akash_enable: Vote: I prefer staggered + recorded. Poll so far: 18/24 in favor. https://tinyurl.com/bootcamp-poll (updated)

jamie_csm: I can recruit 2 more mentors from Partner Success for the NA track. Also propose a mentor shadowing plan for newer mentors (30 min before each session).

lina_mentor: I'll own JP subtitles. Ops — can you enable auto-captions on the recording bot and confirm turnaround for subs?

calendar-bot: Event draft created: "Multi-Account Bootcamp - concurrent tracks (provisional)". Link: https://calendar.redwood/example. Use /accept to confirm.

maria_cs: Action items: 
- Tim: lock priority seats + send list of renewal-risk customers who need 1:1s
- Akash & Lina: confirm mentors roster and JP workflow
- Jamie: recruit 2 partner mentors and set up shadowing
- Ops: enable captions + test recording
I'll close this thread after confirmations. :calendar:

tim_ops: Locking seats today and will DM CSMs for the renewal-watch list.

akash_enable: Roster update: Akash, Lina, Raj, Priya, Marco, Chen (+2 partner mentors pending). I’ll update the sheet by EOD.

jamie_csm: Partner mentors confirmed: Sara and Miguel.

calendar-bot: Reminder set: test recording scheduled in 48h. /remind #customer-success in 2 days

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll publish the updated agenda and attendee invites tomorrow.
